author: maxgenkin

title: After trying several apps
body:
Great app , love the idea , you only must have the ability to show how much have you done a specific habit in general. 
Etc - total Push Ups in week/Month
Total water been drank this week month etc etc..
This will motivate the user. 
Also when a habit is done it goes down to completed , maybe marks it as done but keeps it up so you can add more incase you want to make more than 100% of your daily target etc..
Besides that which can be a lack or can be a soon future improvement , Thanks for it , recommended.
author: moodyomarz

title: Excellent
body:
Well designed and incredibly practical.
The apple watch app works perfectly permitting the input of data on the spot. 
What is better than to compete with ourselves?
I would give 5 stars if the synchronization would work better.
author: Emil.S

body: I was really excited to use this app, it looks really good and nice to use, but then I found out I can only add 3 habits if I don’t have a premium. How can I even use a habit tracker with only 3 habits? I don’t get it.
